# Design point P024

## Description

The system uses centralized repository hosting as the primary access point, with automatic repair of unhealthy or lagging replicas to restore redundancy and service capacity. Foreground automatic garbage collection is rejected, so repository commands do not synchronously trigger garbage collection under this design.
